name: Shard Seeker
summary: It digs through the top four and pulls out the body you needed.

face.name: Shard Seeker

seek.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Human Entity among them and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck.

face.flavor: Every shard is a piece of someone. It keeps them all.
